visual_requirements.description: Bloated plump dark ruddy undead human, linen burial shroud, slightly grown hair/nails/teeth without fangs.
Rising from grave at night, no invented magical powers.

depicted_variant: European folkloric plump ruddy shrouded revenant, not modern gaunt fanged aristocrat.
aura: Nighttime emergence from grave (vampire-c02) and swollen ruddy revenant anatomy (vampire-c07,c08).
artistic_choices: Dark earthy palette and moon rim lighting are editorial.
Opaque linen shroud entirely covers torso and legs.
No fangs, bats, aristocratic costume or magical aura; menace from predatory emergence.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of a solitary folkloric European vampire, a supernatural revenant emerging from its grave at night [vampire-c02]. ANATOMY: one head two eyes two arms two legs, broad plump dark ruddy face, slightly overgrown hair and ordinary teeth without fangs [vampire-c01,c07,c08,c09]. Completely clothed in a thick fully opaque linen burial shroud, torso and legs covered [vampire-c08]. MOMENT: seated at the earthen grave edge, naturally gathering and adjusting the linen wrap with both hands, looking solemnly toward viewer with intensely watchful eyes. No violence or pursuit. CAMERA: very close low-angle three-quarter view, heavy facial features fill upper frame, atmospheric solitary revenant identity unmistakable. SETTING: open earthen grave under moonlight; stones entirely blank [vampire-c02]. LIGHT: one strong moon source, warm earthy low-key painterly shadows, cold rim on coarse linen. SURFACE: coarse shroud, clinging soil, swollen ruddy healthy-looking flesh. MOOD: ominous and imposing through uncanny expression and strange burial clothing. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no attack or stalking or victims or reaching toward viewer, no blood/wounds/assault/gore, no nudity, no text or glyphs/logos/borders/watermarks, no fangs, no extra limbs/fingers, no aura/neon/ribbons, no modern movie or game design. This is a nonviolent solitary folklore portrait.
candidate_choice_notes: Fails Sangar 2 and 7: ordinary plump man sitting calmly in linen; burial context is clear but no imposing supernatural menace. Three-call cap exhausted; no retry.
